blocks.title: Generate and Test
blocks.text: The Generate and Test algorithm generates possible solutions to a problem and tests each one to see whether it meets the required conditions, continuing until a satisfactory solution is found or all possibilities are exhausted.
It is a straightforward, intuitive approach commonly used in artificial intelligence and computer science.

blocks.prompt: When does generate and test stop?
blocks.explanation: When a candidate passes the test, or when every possible candidate has been tried.

items: Generate and test: propose a candidate, test it, repeat until one works or none are left.
